name: Building and Deploying AI in Healthcare Delivery
description: Evaluate clinical AI through a fictional US health-system case: procurement, source audits, silent validation, monitoring, privacy and integration. Produce a bounded evidence portfolio using synthetic materials and branching decisions.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Health and Life Sciences

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building and Deploying AI in Healthcare Delivery

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 24 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Tier a clinical AI intake request by patient impact, autonomy, time-criticality, FDA status and protected-attribute inputs, and select a vendor with pre-signed gates and weights, security attestations, total cost of ownership and an ROI case built on local measures
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Design an ambient-documentation pilot with a stepped-wedge arm, a fixed exposure window, pre-set go/no-go thresholds and a sampled note-versus-audio error audit, and write the go/no-go memo
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Audit an AI-generated discharge summary or portal reply with an inaccuracy, hallucination and omission taxonomy, and test red-flag routing rules for sensitivity on a held-out message set
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Run a silent-mode validation of a vendor deterioration model with physiologic onset and clinician recognition times, and select an alert threshold from sensitivity, PPV, horizon-based calibration and lead time within a unit alert budget
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Reproduce a label-choice bias pattern in a risk score, compare enrollment at equal need across groups, and write the 45 CFR 92.210 inventory and mitigation entry
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Investigate drift with complete outcome denominators and competing explanations; compare recalibration, manufacturer-led change and retirement, and distinguish operational proxy exposure from actual waiting/capacity evidence
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate a vendor PHI flow, de-identification release method, Part 2 provenance/disclosure packet and contract conditions without treating detector accuracy as legal approval
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Specify a CDS Hooks prefetch template and card that meet FDA criterion 4 transparency, and confirm hooks, prefetch, feedback and silent scoring against what your EHR version actually supports
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes
